nvitk.morphology.mst_bridge¶

MST-based bridging of nearby connected components (binary / multilabel).

Builds a complete graph of components with edge weights = nearest-voxel distance, takes a minimum spanning tree (MST), and draws short tubes along MST edges shorter than max_gap. Useful for reconnecting fragmented vessel masks without a global morphological close.

Parameters:

  • labels – Integer label volume (0 = background).

  • close_radius – Morphological close footprint radius before bridging (0 disables).

  • bridge_max_gap – Passed to bridge_binary_components_mst().

  • bridge_radius – Passed to bridge_binary_components_mst().

  • label_ids – Labels to process; default = all positive ids present in labels.
